name: actor_1_safe_bus_stop
description: Bus signals in advance and stops smoothly at a marked bus stop.

name: actor_2_bus_sudden_stop
description: Bus stops abruptly at an unmarked stop to pick up passengers.

name: actor_3_aggressive_lane_change
description: Vehicle changes lanes abruptly at high speed without signaling.

name: actor_4_safe_following
description: Vehicle maintains a safe following distance.

name: actor_5_safe_railway_wait
description: Vehicle stops safely behind the barrier and waits for the train to pass.

name: actor_6_safe_intersection_stop
description: Vehicle comes to a complete stop and yields correctly before proceeding.
